# Headline numbers

Every value is read from a data file by `src/make_headline_numbers.py`. Strip-angle CRBs are 1-sigma, in degrees, with the exact strip symmetry imposed. Primary noise: the sourced 1 pm resonance-wavelength precision (best case 0.1 pm); the noise conversion to n_eff, n_g and MZI phase is DERIVED (formulas in section E). Sets are read out by a ring (n_eff, n_g) and an MZI (phase) per structure. Stages: C = + separate rib angle, D = + n_Si, n_ox, E = + temperature; "realistic" priors: etch depth 2 nm, n_Si 1e-4, n_ox 1e-3, T 1 K (ASSUMED).
